in_arabic.name: قدامة
in_arabic.meaning: قدامة تعني القوة و الصبر و الثبات
in_arabic.long_meaning: قدامة هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه القوة و الصبر و الثبات. و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محمودة في الإسلام. كما أن اسم قدامة ورد في بعض المصادر على أنه اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، و لكن ليس هناك إجماع على ذلك.

in_urdu.name: قدامہ
in_urdu.meaning: قدامہ کا مطلب ہے طاقت، صبر اور استحکام
in_urdu.long_meaning: قدامہ ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے طاقت، صبر اور استحکام۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے اور اکثر مسلمان اس کا انتخاب کرتے ہیں کیونکہ اس کے معنی خوبصورت اور قابل ستائش ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: क़ुदामा
in_hindi.meaning: क़ुदामा का अर्थ है शक्ति, धैर्य और स्थिरता
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़ुदामा एक मस्कलिन नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से निकला है। इसका अर्थ है शक्ति, धैर्य और स्थिरता। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण स्थान रखता है और अक्सर मुसलमान इसका चयन करते हैं क्योंकि इसके अर्थ सुंदर और प्रशंसनीय हैं।

in_pashto.name: قدامه
in_pashto.meaning: قدامه د ځواک، صبر او ثابت پښتو
in_pashto.long_meaning: قدامه يو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه يی اخستي دي. دغه نوم د ځواک، صبر او ثابت په معنا دی. دا نوم د پښتنو په دود او رسم کې ډیر اهمیت لري او ډیری پښتني مسلمانان دا نوم غوره کوي ځکه چې د معنی یې ښکلې او د ستاینې وړ دي.

in_english.name: Qudamah
in_english.meaning: Qudamah means strength, patience, and stability
in_english.long_meaning: Qudamah is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It means strength, patience, and stability. The name holds positive connotations in Islamic tradition and is chosen by many Muslim parents due to its beautiful and commendable meaning. Etymologically, it is derived from the Arabic root 'q-d-m' which signifies 'to be in front' or 'to advance', reflecting leadership qualities and forward-thinking attributes.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Qudamah" carries a strong cultural impact, especially in the Islamic community as it is believed that the name represents a leader, someone who takes the front row and paves the way for others. Qudamah is a name that resonates with pride, a name given to someone who command respect and is recognized for their bravery and courage to lead their community, often in times of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper, spiritual level, the name "Qudamah" is believed to evoke a sense of humility and obedience. As a "forerunner" or someone who comes before others, the person bearing this name is reminded of the responsibility to lead, guide, and protect those who come after. The name embodies the Sunnah of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), who often beckoned others to come forward in prayers, encouraging unity and consensus within the community. In this way, the name Qudamah serves as a reminder to continuously strive to be a role model, a leader in good deeds and righteous actions, and ultimately, a servant of God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Qudamah ibn Ja'far al-Harithi was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Qudamah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Qudamah was a member of the Banu Haritha tribe and was one of the earliest converts to Islam. He was known for his bravery and generosity, and was often in the company of the Prophet Muhammad. He participated in several battles and was a trusted advisor to the Prophet.
